text: {"sql":"WITH period_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-07-01' AND created_at < '2026-08-01' AND status = '已完成' GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repurchase_rate FROM period_orders","unanswerable":false,"unanswerableReason":""}
